# Builtin facts

<!-- Generated by `aver facts --markdown > docs/builtin-facts.md`; edit `src/ir/proof_steps/facts.rs`, not this file. -->

A law cites a builtin fact by name in `using`, as it cites a law of its own program. Each fact holds for lists of every element type, so its givens have no element type here. The proof of each fact is written as steps and travels with every citation: the kernel written in Aver checks it before the law may use the fact, and Lean states the fact once, for every element type, and proves it with the same steps. When the steps stop at a term a fact's left side matches, `aver proof` names the fact in a hint. `aver facts` prints this list.

## `List.len.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.len(List.concat(a, b)) => List.len(a) + List.len(b)
```

## `List.concat.assoc`

```aver
given a, b, c
List.concat(List.concat(a, b), c) => List.concat(a, List.concat(b, c))
```

## `List.concat.rightIdentity`

```aver
given a
List.concat(a, []) => a
```

## `List.len.nonneg`

```aver
given a
List.len(a) >= 0 => true
```

## `List.take.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.take(List.concat(a, b), List.len(a)) => a
```

Proved from `List.len.nonneg`.

## `List.drop.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.drop(List.concat(a, b), List.len(a)) => b
```

Proved from `List.len.nonneg`.

## `List.len.ofReverse`

```aver
given a
List.len(List.reverse(a)) => List.len(a)
```

Proved from `List.len.ofConcat`.

## `List.reverse.ofConcat`

```aver
given a, b
List.reverse(List.concat(a, b)) => List.concat(List.reverse(b), List.reverse(a))
```

Proved from `List.concat.assoc`, `List.concat.rightIdentity`.

## `List.reverse.involutive`

```aver
given a
List.reverse(List.reverse(a)) => a
```

Proved from `List.reverse.ofConcat`.
